# video-agent commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-skill-cli.ts from packages/cli/src/catalog.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command, flag and exit code of the CLI. [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md) has the short version; the `create-video`
skill's recipes say what to make.

## Set up

```sh
npx netlify-video-agent --version          # or: npm i -g netlify-video-agent, then video-agent …
video-agent login --url {{SITE_URL}}        # approve this terminal in the browser; the key is saved for you
printf %s "$VIDEO_AGENT_API_KEY" | video-agent login --url {{SITE_URL}} --key - --no-save   # CI: a key, not saved
video-agent whoami
```

Instead of `login`, set `VIDEO_AGENT_URL={{SITE_URL}}` and `VIDEO_AGENT_KEY=nva_…` in the environment. Flags win
over the environment, which wins over the saved config. Never put a key on the command line or in a prompt.

## Making a video

```sh
video-agent create "A 20-second launch video for our webhooks feature" --aspect 16:9 --wait --out ./webhooks --json
```

`--wait` follows the run (3 to 8 minutes) with progress on stderr; `--out` downloads the MP4, poster and captions.
Upload screenshots or logos first with `video-agent media upload <file> --caption "…"` and pass the ids with
`--media`, or pass the file to `--media` directly and it is uploaded first. A revision changes only what you say:
`video-agent revise <video> "Make the end card orange" --wait`.

From a pull request: `video-agent brief pr <url> | video-agent create --prompt-file - --wait`.

No deployment? `video-agent local "<prompt>"` makes the video on this machine with your own coding agent.

## Output and errors

With `--json`, stdout is exactly one JSON object: what the command made or read (a video has `id`,
`latestVersion` and `versions[]` with `status`), or `{ "error": { "code", "message", "requestId" } }`. Progress
and prompts go to stderr. `<video>` is an id (`vid_…`), its web address or a share link. Add `--verbose` for
one JSON line per request on stderr, with request ids.

| Exit | Meaning                                                                   |
| ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 0    | Done.                                                                     |
| 1    | Something else failed (network, server error); the message says what.     |
| 2    | The command was called wrong (unknown flag, missing argument, bad value). |
| 3    | No key, a revoked key, or a login that was denied or expired.             |
| 4    | The video or item is missing, or your role cannot see it.                 |
| 5    | The video failed (`--wait`); `get <id>` shows why.                        |
| 6    | `--wait` gave up (`--timeout`); the video is still being made.            |
| 7    | Not now: a run is in progress, a feature is off, or the state changed.    |
| 8    | Too many requests; retry after a pause.                                   |
| 9    | This server does not offer that feature yet.                              |

## Flags every command takes

- `--json`: Print one JSON object on stdout and nothing else there.
- `--verbose`: Log each request and step as JSON lines on stderr (or VIDEO_AGENT_DEBUG=1).
- `--url <value>`: The deployment (else VIDEO_AGENT_URL, else the config file).
- `--key <value>`: An API key, nva_… (else VIDEO_AGENT_KEY, else the config file). '-' reads stdin.
- `--help`: Show help for the command.

## Commands

### login

Get an API key by approving this CLI in the browser (asks for your site the first time), or paste one.

```sh
video-agent login
video-agent login --url https://acme-video.netlify.app
printf %s "$KEY" | video-agent login --key - --no-save
```

- `--no-browser`: Print the address and code only (SSH, containers).
- `--no-save`: With --key -: check the key, keep it out of the config file.

### logout

Forget the saved key.

```sh
video-agent logout
video-agent logout --revoke
```

- `--revoke`: Revoke it on the server too.

### whoami

Show who the key acts as, and the server.

```sh
video-agent whoami
video-agent whoami
```

### create

Make a video from a prompt.

```sh
video-agent create [prompt]
video-agent create "A 20-second launch video for webhooks" --aspect 16:9 --wait --out webhooks.mp4
video-agent create "A demo of adding a webhook" --recording ./take1 --hide-text "Acme Labs" --wait
```

- `--aspect <value>`: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5.
- `--title <value>`: The video title.
- `--look <value>`: A Look id (video-agent looks), or none.
- `--engine <value>`: A render engine id.
- `--plan`: Ask the planning questions and stop (needs planning on the server).
- `--plan-id <value>`: With --answers: answer a plan and make the video from its brief.
- `--answers <value>`: The answers: a JSON file, or '-' for stdin.
- `--duration <n>`: Target length in seconds.
- `--sound <value>`: silent, music or music_sfx.
- `--voice <value>`: A voice-over in this voice (e.g. af_heart), or off.
- `--media <value>` (repeatable): A media id, or a file to upload first (file:"caption" sets its caption). Repeatable, up to 12.
- `--tag <value>` (repeatable): A tag to file it under, like demo. Repeatable, up to 10. (needs tags on the server)
- `--webhook-url <value>`: Also send this video's webhook events here.
- `--idempotency-key <value>`: Retrying with the same key never makes two.
- `--prompt-file <value>`: Read the prompt from a file, or '-' for stdin.
- `--recording <value>`: Make a demo from a screen recording: a media id, a video-agent record folder or an MP4 (uploaded first).
- `--trim <value>`: With --recording: the seconds to use, in,out (like 2,48.5).
- `--crop <value>`: With --recording: the part of the picture to use, x,y,width,height as fractions (like 0,0.08,1,0.84).
- `--privacy`: With --recording: privacy mode (find and hide emails, keys, tokens, URLs with ids…).
- `--hide-text <value>` (repeatable): With --recording: text to hide wherever it shows. Repeatable.
- `--quick`: With --recording: a Quick demo, made with no agent authoring.
- `--out <value>`: Follow it, then download the video, poster and captions into this folder.
- `--wait`: Follow the run until the video is ready.
- `--timeout <value>`: With --wait: give up after this long: seconds, or 30m, 2h (exit 6).

### revise

Make the next version of a video.

```sh
video-agent revise <video> <change>
video-agent revise vid_01… "Make the end card orange" --wait
```

- `--from-version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).
- `--comments <value>`: Comment ids to address, comma-separated.
- `--scene <value>` (repeatable): Only redo these scenes (id or label; repeatable).
- `--look <value>`: Restyle with this Look, or none for no look.
- `--duration <n>`: Target length in seconds.
- `--sound <value>`: silent, music or music_sfx.
- `--voice <value>`: A voice-over in this voice (e.g. af_heart), or off.
- `--media <value>` (repeatable): A media id, or a file to upload first (file:"caption" sets its caption). Repeatable, up to 12.
- `--webhook-url <value>`: Also send this video's webhook events here.
- `--idempotency-key <value>`: Retrying with the same key never makes two.
- `--prompt-file <value>`: Read the prompt from a file, or '-' for stdin.
- `--out <value>`: Follow it, then download the video, poster and captions into this folder.
- `--wait`: Follow the run until the video is ready.
- `--timeout <value>`: With --wait: give up after this long: seconds, or 30m, 2h (exit 6).

### redo

Redo one or more scenes only. Needs the server feature "scoped_revision" (see whoami).

```sh
video-agent redo <video> <change>
video-agent redo vid_01… --scene intro "Shorter title"
```

- `--scene <value>` (repeatable): A scene, by id or label (repeatable).
- `--from-version <n>`: The version the scenes are from (default: the latest ready).
- `--idempotency-key <value>`: Retrying with the same key never makes two.
- `--wait`: Follow the run until the video is ready.
- `--timeout <value>`: With --wait: give up after this long: seconds, or 30m, 2h (exit 6).

### scenes

```sh
video-agent scenes <video>
video-agent scenes vid_01…
```

- `--version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).

- `--look <value>`: A Look id, or none (default: the source's).
- `--duration <n>`: Target length in seconds.
- `--sound <value>`: silent, music or music_sfx.
- `--voice <value>`: A voice-over in this voice (e.g. af_heart), or off.
- `--media <value>` (repeatable): A media id, or a file to upload first (file:"caption" sets its caption). Repeatable, up to 12.
- `--webhook-url <value>`: Also send this video's webhook events here.
- `--idempotency-key <value>`: Retrying with the same key never makes two.
- `--prompt-file <value>`: Read the prompt from a file, or '-' for stdin.
- `--out <value>`: Follow it, then download the video, poster and captions into this folder.
- `--wait`: Follow the run until the video is ready.
- `--timeout <value>`: With --wait: give up after this long: seconds, or 30m, 2h (exit 6).

### looks

List the Looks. Needs the server feature "looks" (see whoami).

```sh
video-agent looks
video-agent looks
video-agent looks --json
```

### restyle

Restyle a video with another Look. Needs the server feature "looks" (see whoami).

```sh
video-agent restyle <video> <look>
video-agent restyle vid_01… kinetic --wait
```

- `--wait`: Follow the run until the video is ready.
- `--timeout <value>`: With --wait: give up after this long: seconds, or 30m, 2h (exit 6).

### get

Show a video.

```sh
video-agent get <video>
video-agent get vid_01… --json
```

### list

List videos.

```sh
video-agent list
video-agent list --mine --json
```

- `--mine`: Only yours.
- `--search <value>`: Search titles and prompts.
- `--status <value>`: queued, running, finishing, ready, failed, cancelled or timed_out.
- `--published`: Only published ones.
- `--favorite`: Only the ones you starred.
- `--tag <value>`: Only videos with any of these tags (comma-separated: demo,launch).
- `--without-tag <value>`: Leave out videos with any of these tags (comma-separated).
- `--limit <n>`: How many per page.
- `--all`: Every page, not just the first.

### tag

Set a video's tags. Needs the server feature "tags" (see whoami).

```sh
video-agent tag <video> [tags…]
video-agent tag vid_01… demo
video-agent list --without-tag demo
```

### wait

Follow a run until the video is ready.

```sh
video-agent wait <video>
video-agent wait vid_01… --timeout 1800
```

- `--version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).
- `--timeout <value>`: Give up after this long: seconds, or 30m, 2h (exit 6).

### download

Download a version's files.

```sh
video-agent download <video>
video-agent download vid_01… --out launch.mp4
```

- `--version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).
- `--file <value>`: video, poster, gif, captions, narration or all.
- `--out <value>`: A file, or a folder (with --file all, default <id>-v<n>).

### publish

Publish a version: share link, MP4 link and embed snippet.

```sh
video-agent publish <video>
video-agent publish vid_01… --json
```

- `--version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).
- `--transcript`: Offer the transcript on the share page.

### unpublish

Take a version offline.

```sh
video-agent unpublish <video>
video-agent unpublish vid_01…
```

- `--version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).

### cancel

Cancel a running version.

```sh
video-agent cancel <video>
video-agent cancel vid_01…
```

- `--version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).

### retry

Try a failed version again.

```sh
video-agent retry <video>
video-agent retry vid_01… --wait
```

- `--version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).
- `--wait`: Follow the run until the video is ready.
- `--timeout <value>`: With --wait: give up after this long: seconds, or 30m, 2h (exit 6).

### comments list

List a video's comments.

```sh
video-agent comments list <video>
video-agent comments list vid_01…
```

- `--version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).

### comments add

Comment on a version.

```sh
video-agent comments add <video> <text>
video-agent comments add vid_01… "Logo too small" --at 12
```

- `--version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).
- `--at <n>`: At this time, in seconds.

### verdict

Approve a version or ask for changes.

```sh
video-agent verdict <video> <verdict>
video-agent verdict vid_01… approve
```

- `--version <n>`: The version (default: the latest).
- `--note <value>`: A note with the verdict.

### media upload

Upload files to the media library; waits until each is ready.

```sh
video-agent media upload <file…>
video-agent media upload ./checkout.png --caption "New checkout page"
video-agent media upload ./take1 --role screen-recording
```

- `--caption <value>`: What the file shows (the agent reads it).
- `--role <value>`: screen-recording: a recording for a demo (an MP4, or a video-agent record folder).
- `--trace <value>`: With --role screen-recording: the recording's trace.json.

### media list

List the media library.

```sh
video-agent media list
video-agent media list --json
```

- `--kind <value>`: image, svg, video, font, audio or pdf.
- `--search <value>`: Search names and captions.

### media get

Show a media item.

```sh
video-agent media get <id>
video-agent media get med_01…
```

video-agent keys list
video-agent keys list

### keys create

Explains where API keys come from (the API keys page, or login).

```sh
video-agent keys create
video-agent keys create
```

### open

Open a video's page in the browser.

```sh
video-agent open <video>
video-agent open vid_01…
```

### api

Call any API route, like gh api.

```sh
video-agent api <method> <path>
video-agent api GET /api/v1/me/usage
```

- `--data <value>`: A JSON body, or @file.

### doctor

Check Node, the config, the server and (for local mode) the tools.

```sh
video-agent doctor
video-agent doctor --json
```

### brief pr

Print the GitHub Action's brief for a pull request (pipe it into create --prompt-file -).

```sh
video-agent brief pr <pr>
video-agent brief pr https://github.com/acme/web/pull/123
video-agent brief pr https://github.com/acme/web/pull/123 | video-agent create --prompt-file - --wait
```

- `--prompt <value>`: Your own words, added to the brief ("for sales engineers").
- `--context`: Put the PR's text in a context block (servers that list context).
- `--untrusted`: Use only the title and files, not the author's words.

### brief release

Print a changelog brief for a release, from its notes on GitHub or a file.

```sh
video-agent brief release <tag>
video-agent brief release v2.4.0 --repo acme/web
video-agent brief release "$CI_COMMIT_TAG" --repo acme/web --notes-file CHANGELOG.md
```

- `--repo <value>`: owner/name (default: GITHUB_REPOSITORY).
- `--notes-file <value>`: Read the notes from a file (or - for stdin) instead of GitHub.
- `--prompt <value>`: Your own words, added to the brief.
- `--url <value>`: Where the video should end (the product or the release page).
- `--context`: Put the notes in a context block (servers that list context).

### brief changelog

Print a changelog brief from the pull requests merged since a date.

```sh
video-agent brief changelog
video-agent brief changelog --since 2026-11-01 --repo acme/web
```

- `--since <value>`: YYYY-MM-DD.
- `--repo <value>`: owner/name (default: GITHUB_REPOSITORY).
- `--prompt <value>`: Your own words, added to the brief.
- `--url <value>`: Where the video should end.

### record

Record a web app in Chromium with a pointer trace, for a demo (on this machine, no server).

```sh
video-agent record <url>
video-agent record https://app.example.com --out ./take1
video-agent record https://app.example.com --privacy --hide-text "Acme Labs" --hide ".account-email"
video-agent record http://localhost:3000 --script ./tour.mjs --headless --out ./tour
```

- `--out <value>`: The recording folder (recording.mp4, trace.json).
- `--viewport <value>`: The window size, like 1280x800.
- `--dpr <n>`: Device pixel ratio: 2 (sharp zooms) or 1.
- `--fps <n>`: 24, 25 or 30.
- `--duration <n>`: Record this many seconds and stop (else r starts and s stops).
- `--script <value>`: A module whose default export drives the page (a scripted tour).
- `--headless`: No window (with --duration or --script).
- `--hide <value>` (repeatable): A CSS selector to hide wherever it shows (password fields always are). Repeatable.
- `--hide-text <value>` (repeatable): Text to hide wherever it shows on the page (a customer's name). Repeatable.
- `--privacy`: Privacy mode: find and hide emails, keys, tokens, URLs with ids, card and phone numbers.
- `--storage-state <value>`: A sign-in file to start from (kept outside --out).
- `--save-storage-state <value>`: Save the sign-in here when you stop (mode 600).
- `--no-target-names`: Don't record clicked elements' names.
- `--upload`: Then upload it to the library (needs a sign-in, like create).
- `--make <value>`: Then upload it and make a demo with this prompt.

### local

Make a video on this machine with your own coding agent, inside its sandbox.

```sh
video-agent local <prompt>
video-agent local "A 20-second launch video for our webhooks feature" --aspect 16:9
video-agent local "A product teaser" --voice --sound music --media ./shot.png:"The new dashboard"
video-agent local --look ./looks/my-look "A 20-second launch video for our webhooks feature"
```

- `--agent <value>`: The coding agent: claude (the one this version supports).
- `--aspect <value>`: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5.
- `--duration <n>`: Target length in seconds.
- `--sound <value>`: silent, music or music_sfx.
- `--voice`: Add a spoken voice-over (needs Python 3.10 to 3.13).
- `--media <value>` (repeatable): A file to put in the video (file:"caption" sets its caption). Repeatable, up to 12.
- `--context <value>`: Your brand folder (default ./context, else a neutral one).
- `--look <value>`: A Look: an id bundled with the CLI (video-agent looks lists a server's), or a look folder.
- `--out <value>`: Where the video goes (default ./videos/<slug>).
- `--keep`: Keep the workspace (for debugging). A failed run's is always kept.
- `--timeout <value>`: Give up after this long: 30m, 1h (default 40m).

### local demo

Make a demo from a screen recording on this machine (--quick: no agent, no model).

```sh
video-agent local demo <recording>
video-agent local demo ./take1 --quick
video-agent local demo ./take1 --prompt "Adding a webhook, for new admins" --privacy
```

- `--prompt <value>`: What the demo should show (default: the steps of the recording).
- `--quick`: A Quick demo: composed straight from the plan, no agent.
- `--agent <value>`: The coding agent: claude (the one this version supports).
- `--aspect <value>`: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5.
- `--duration <n>`: Target length in seconds.
- `--trim <value>`: The seconds of the recording to use, in,out (like 2,48.5).
- `--crop <value>`: The part of the picture to use, x,y,width,height as fractions (like 0,0.08,1,0.84).
- `--trace <value>`: The recording's trace.json (default: the one beside it).
- `--privacy`: Privacy mode: find and hide emails, keys, tokens, URLs with ids…
- `--hide-text <value>` (repeatable): Text to hide wherever it shows. Repeatable.
- `--look <value>`: A Look bundled with the CLI, or a look folder.
- `--context <value>`: Your brand folder (default ./context, else a neutral one).
- `--out <value>`: Where the video goes (default ./videos/<slug>).
- `--keep`: Keep the workspace (for debugging). A failed run's is always kept.
- `--timeout <value>`: Give up after this long: 30m, 1h (default 40m).

### local revise

Make the next version of a video you made with local.

```sh
video-agent local revise <dir> <change>
video-agent local revise ./videos/webhooks-launch "Make the end card orange"
video-agent local revise ./videos/webhooks-launch --scene demo "Show the preview URL"
video-agent local revise ./videos/webhooks-launch --voice --sound music "Add a voice-over and music"
```

- `--agent <value>`: The coding agent: claude.
- `--from-version <n>`: The version to change (default: the latest).
- `--scene <value>` (repeatable): Only redo these scenes (id or label; repeatable). The rest stay as they are.
- `--sound <value>`: silent, music or music_sfx. Default: the sound of the version you're changing.
- `--voice`: Add a spoken voice-over (needs Python 3.10 to 3.13).
- `--no-voice`: Drop the voice-over.
- `--keep`: Keep the workspace (for debugging). A failed run's is always kept.
- `--timeout <value>`: Give up after this long: 30m, 1h (default 40m).
